name: Severe-warning exposure
calculation: Count distinct storms where the province reached Wind Signal 3 or higher
source_columns: province_signals.sid; season; tcws_1; tcws_2; tcws_3; tcws_4; tcws_5
trend: Median province-level value by calendar year
why_it_matters: Measures severe-warning exposure relevant to identifying places for monitoring

name: Rice-price upside swing
calculation: sqrt(sum(rise_pct^2) / (number_of_readings - 1)); falls and unchanged readings are zero
trend: Median price-covered province value by calendar year
why_it_matters: Measures the size of upward rice-price movements relevant to food-price monitoring

name: Top five repeatedly hit provinces
calculation: Rank provinces by repeat severe-warning hits using the 14-day rule and keep the top five; ties are alphabetical
source_columns: province_signals.sid; season; issued_time; tcws_3; tcws_4; tcws_5
trend: Ranked top-five province list by calendar year
why_it_matters: Gives stakeholders a clear priority list for monitoring repeated severe-warning activity
